senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Solomon, king of Israel.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 10a:12">Ber. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>כנגד מי אמר ש׳ וכ׳</he> with reference to whom did Solomon say that verse (<cite ref="Proverbs 31:26">Prov. XXXI, 26</cite>)? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 20b:15">Snh. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>בתחלה מלך ש׳ על העליונים וכ׳</he> Solomon ruled first over those on high &c. Y. ib. II, 20ᶜ <he>ירד מלאך … ש׳ וכ׳</he> an angel came down in the image of S. and made him rise from his throne &c.; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 2:2:3">Koh. R. to II, 2</cite>.

<cite ref="Pesachim 36b:13">Pes. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>אפי׳ כמצות של ש׳</he> even unleavened cakes like those of Solomon (of the finest flour) may be used on the Passover; Y. ib. II, 29ᵇ bot. <he>מצה שלמה</he> (insert <he>של</he>, or read: <cite ref="M02371"><he>מַצַּת</he></cite>).
